text: pe. yā saññā . ye saṅkhārā jātā pātubhūtā tesaṃ uppādo paññāyati vayo paññāyati ṭhitānaṃ aññathattaṃ paññāyati . yaṃ viññāṇaṃ jātaṃ pātubhūtaṃ tassa uppādo paññāyati vayo paññāyati ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati . imesaṃ kho āvuso dhammānaṃ uppādo paññāyati vayo paññāyati ṭhitānaṃ aññathattaṃ paññāyatīti . evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante evaṃ byākareyyanti . [82] sādhu sādhu ānanda yaṃ kho ānanda rūpaṃ
